title: IDEATION AND CREATIVE THINKING
description: Focuses on the creative process applied toward business and societal problems, specifically, on identifying and developing innovative solutions to complex problems, fostering a creative culture, and providing practical tools for enhancing individual and team creativity. Uses exercises, simulations, and real-world business scenarios.
registration_restrictions: Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 4pm-5:50pm in AUST 216 - Austin Hall 216 (9/23 to 12/4)
